TRIP TREK INDIA PRESENTS

Jaisalmer: Kuldhara & Longewala

Luxury desert camps at the Sam Sand Dunes, a camel and jeep safari, and the Golden City’s most famous sights. A 5-day group trip from Delhi.

5D / 4N itinerary
Delhi to Delhi
Desert camps at Sam
Camel & jeep safari
View Itinerary Book This Trip
THE DESTINATION

About Jaisalmer

Jaisalmer is the Golden City of the Thar Desert, a former medieval trading centre in western Rajasthan, known for its yellow sandstone architecture. Its hilltop fort is a living city, with homes, temples and winding lanes inside the walls.

On this trip you stay in luxury camps at the Sam Sand Dunes, ride a camel and a jeep across the sand, and enjoy a cultural night with folk dance, DJ and bonfire. You also visit the Longewala War Memorial, the Tanot Rai Mata Temple and the mysterious abandoned village of Kuldhara, with a tour guide and coordinator on the trip.

Delhi / Gurgaon

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Overnight journey — glimpses of Pushkar, Ajmer and Pokhran on the way.

Sam Sand Dunes — stay in luxury camps in the heart of the desert.

Camel & jeep safari — two ways to explore the dunes.

Traditional welcome — arti, tika and dhol when you return to camp.

Culture & campfire — folk dance, a cultural programme, DJ night and bonfire.

Longewala War Memorial — the museum and the story of the 1971 battle.

Tanot Rai Mata Temple — darshan at the famous desert temple.

Kuldhara & Bada Bagh — the abandoned village and the royal cenotaphs of Jaisalmer.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Pickup: Pickup from Gurgaon. Your pickup point and time are confirmed by our team before departure.
  • Departure: Board the vehicle and set off for the Sam Sand Dunes.
  • Overnight journey: Travel through the night. Along the way you may get glimpses of places like Pushkar, Ajmer and Pokhran.
  • Arrival: Reach Sam in the morning or afternoon, check in to the camps, freshen up and have lunch.
  • Safaris: Enjoy a jeep safari and a camel safari on the dunes.
  • Evening: Return to the camps by about 6:45 PM for a traditional welcome with arti, tika and dhol.
  • Night: Freshen up, then enjoy a cultural programme, folk dance, DJ night and bonfire.
  • Stay: Dinner and overnight stay in the camps.
  • Morning: Wake up, freshen up and have breakfast, then depart for the Longewala War Memorial museum.
  • Longewala: Spend around an hour at the museum. Lunch in Longewala is at your own cost.
  • Tanot Rai Mata Temple: About 15 minutes are given for darshan at the temple.
  • Evening: Return to the camps for a DJ night, bonfire and cultural programme.
  • Stay: Dinner and overnight stay in the camps.
  • Morning: Wake up, freshen up and have breakfast, then depart for Kuldhara, the abandoned village.
  • Kuldhara: Explore the ruins and hear the history and legends of this mysterious village.
  • Bada Bagh: Visit the garden complex with the royal cenotaphs (chhatris) of Jaisalmer rulers.
  • Free time: Enjoy sightseeing, photography and serene desert views.
  • Return: In the evening, begin the overnight journey back to Delhi / Gurgaon.
  • Arrival: Reach Delhi / Gurgaon in the morning, at around 9 to 10 AM.
  • Trip ends: Our trip concludes here. We hope to see you again on the next adventure!
